The '''A-type Stiletto''' was designed to serve as a space superiority [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated]] for an anonymous customer. The manufacturer later offered to sell copies of the highly personalized design to customers who could afford them.

==Characteristics==
The A-type Stiletto-class was a sleek needle-shaped fighter built around its two primary weapon systems: a highly accurate long-nosed [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and a single-shot missile launcher. While the specialized missiles which the launcher fired were very accurate and highly lethal against starfighters, they could only be obtained on [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] and were costly.
